action.$description: Primary actions, like the default button.

background.$description: The background of a primary action, like the default button.

background-hover.$description: The background of a primary action, like the default button, under the pointer.

background-active.$description: The background of a primary action, like the default button, while it is pressed.

foreground.$description: Text and border of the intent on the surfaces and on the neutral backgrounds, like an outlined button.

background.$description: The background of a secondary action.

background-hover.$description: The background of a secondary action, under the pointer.

background-active.$description: The background of a secondary action, while it is pressed.

foreground.$description: Text and border of the intent on the surfaces and on the neutral backgrounds, like an outlined button.

background.$description: The background of a success intent.

background-hover.$description: The background of a success intent, under the pointer.

background-active.$description: The background of a success intent, while it is pressed.

foreground.$description: Text and border of the intent on the surfaces and on the neutral backgrounds, like an outlined button.

background.$description: The background of a warning intent.

background-hover.$description: The background of a warning intent, under the pointer.

background-active.$description: The background of a warning intent, while it is pressed.

foreground.$description: Text and border of the intent on the surfaces and on the neutral backgrounds, like an outlined button.

danger.$description: A destructive action or an error.

background.$description: The background of a destructive action or an error.

background-hover.$description: The background of a destructive action or an error, under the pointer.

background-active.$description: The background of a destructive action or an error, while it is pressed.

foreground.$description: Text and border of the intent on the surfaces and on the neutral backgrounds, like an outlined button.

background.$description: The background of an information intent.

background-hover.$description: The background of an information intent, under the pointer.

background-active.$description: The background of an information intent, while it is pressed.

foreground.$description: Text and border of the intent on the surfaces and on the neutral backgrounds, like an outlined button.

neutral.$description: Neutral actions and controls, without intent, like the remove button of a tag.

background.$description: The background of a neutral control, like the remove button of a tag.

background-hover.$description: The background of a neutral control, like the remove button of a tag, under the pointer.

background-active.$description: The background of a neutral control, like the remove button of a tag, while it is pressed.

raised.$description: A surface above the page, like a modal.

danger.$description: An error message, on the surfaces.

default.$description: Decorative borders and separators, like the edge of a popover or of a header. A form control uses color.border.control.

control.$description: The border of a form control: 3:1 against the surfaces (WCAG 1.4.11).

focus-ring.$description: The focus indicator, on the surfaces.

transparent.$description: No color: the background of a plain button, the border of a filled one.
